key_insight: An H₂-optimal design framework identifies riblet profiles that maximize turbulence attenuation at a fixed spanwise spacing.
engineering_relevance: Systematic riblet-shape optimization could guide drag-reducing channel surfaces without exhaustive searches over predefined geometries.
method: Model riblets using volume penalization in linearized Navier–Stokes dynamics.
Recast penalization as structured state feedback.
Optimize velocity-fluctuation variance and riblet-induced dynamical augmentations at constant bulk flux.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports optimal wall-normal profiles for fixed riblet spacing but provides no quantitative attenuation results or experimental validation.
watch_item: Optimality is model-based and spacing-specific; nonlinear-flow validation is needed to establish realized drag reduction.
paper_title: $H_2$-optimal riblet profiles for turbulence suppression in channel flows
